character: Fastest street circuit on the calendar — high average speed, narrow track, and unforgiving concrete walls. Demands commitment through blind, high-speed corners with little room for error.

corners.name: Turn 1
corners.technique: Light lift, smooth turn-in, commit to the wall proximity
corners.trap: Lifting too much and losing momentum into the following sequence

corners.name: Turn 13
corners.type: long, banked, fast corner taken while still braking
corners.technique: High commitment corner — brake and turn-in simultaneously on the banking, smooth steering only
corners.trap: Any hesitation or correction near the wall is costly and dangerous

corners.name: Turn 22
corners.technique: Brake in a straight line before turn-in, prioritise a clean exit
corners.trap: Late braking near the wall leaving no margin for error

corners.name: Turn 27
corners.technique: Late apex, clean exit — feeds the longest straight on the lap
corners.trap: Compromised exit here costs the most time of any corner on the lap
